name: session-create-device-login-202

graded_by.test: core/internal/httpapi/device_login_test.go — TestAPromptModeCreateAnswers202WithATicketAndListsNoSession: 202 with device_login_id, ticket and expires_in, no session in GET /sessions, no worker placed, nothing audited, and no field of the request in the answer

description: A create in prompt mode (`connection: new` with `login {user, auth: {kind: prompt}}`) answers 202 with a device login and its one-time ticket, `DeviceLoginPending {device_login_id, ticket, expires_in}`, and no session: nothing is listed, placed, dialled, recorded or audited until the surface redeems the ticket on GET /ws/attach with `device_login_attach` (device-login steps 3 to 8). The body carries no secret: the branch has no field for one. `expires_in` is the ticket's lifetime, 1 to 60 seconds, and an unattached device login ends when it passes (OPEN-R1 (a)). The 202 is its own closed shape, never `Ticket`, whose `session_id` binding stays true. The answer carries no `session` and none of the request's values. `recording_acknowledged` is accepted and changes nothing while `GET /auth/me` says `recording.login_input` is false, so a surface may always send it.
